svg.text: Each panel is a fabric or switch capability covered in documentation/modeling/ and priced with code/core/collective_cost.py
Any-to-any through one crossbar; one port of BW per rank.
Ring, DBT, pairwise run at their pure α-β cost.
Dim-decomposed ring AR / AG / RS: α grows as Σ(di​ − 1).
A2A is bisection-bound: BW term (dmax​ / 8) · M/BW.
k-D mesh: torus minus wraparound; A2A term (dmax​ / 4) · M/BW.
Full mesh: a dedicated link per pair; no switch, so no INC.
Leaf–spine tiers; oversubscription s caps the upper tier's
AR ≡ inner RS → outer AR on M·L/N → inner AG.
AG / RS are its halves; A2A cannot telescope — keep it in the pod.
Every INC primitive costs 2·αswitch​ (2k·αswitch​ over k tiers).
Only AR gains bandwidth: 2·M/BW in software → M/BW.
▲ push Vi​ up (reduce in the switch)
